map.由每期付款、利率与期数求期初年金现值: Present Value of an Annuity Due from Periodic Payment, Rate and Periods
map.输入每期付款 PMT、每期利率 r、期数 n，求期初年金现值。: Enter periodic payment PMT, periodic rate r and periods n to find the annuity-due present value.
map.📖 查看「由每期付款、利率与期数求期初年金现值 使用指南」: View "Present Value of an Annuity Due from Periodic Payment, Rate and Periods User Guide"
map.PV=PMT×[1−(1+r)^(−n)]÷r×(1+r)，期初年金每笔提前一期: PV = PMT × [1 − (1+r)^(−n)] ÷ r × (1+r); each annuity-due payment occurs one period earlier and is discounted one fewer period, so its present value exceeds the same-parameter ordinary annuity (e.g. a mortgage monthly payment).
map.评估房租、保费等期初付款现金流的当前价值。: Value the current worth of beginning-of-period payment streams such as rent and insurance.
map.租赁方案现值测算。: Estimate the present value of lease options.
map.每期 1,000、月利率 0.5%、12 期期初年金现值: Annuity-due PV at 1,000 per period, monthly rate 0.5%, 12 periods
map.期初年金现值为什么高于期末？: Why is the annuity-due present value higher than the ordinary?
map.每笔付款提前一期发生，折现期数少一期，故现值更高。差额约为一期利息的现值。: Each payment occurs one period earlier and is discounted one fewer period, so the PV is higher. The difference is about the present value of one period of interest.
map.和房贷月供现值的关系？: What is its relation to the mortgage monthly-payment present value?
map.房贷月供是期末年金（月初放款、月末首次还款），用普通年金现值；房租是典型期初年金: A mortgage monthly payment is an ordinary annuity (funded at month start, first repayment at month end) using ordinary-annuity PV; rent is a typical annuity due — the two formulas differ by a (1+r) factor.
